subject: SF AI Conf / On-site Demo + Exec Dinner — scheduling
messages:
From: Sanjay Mehta <sanjay@fastscale.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Lee <hannah.lee@fastscale.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: SF AI Conf week - onsite demo + exec dinner

Hi Marissa,

Hope you're well - our team will be in SF for the AI Conference the week of June 24th and we'd love to do an on-site run-through of Redwood's inference platform at our office (Mission Bay). Our CTO would also like to do a short exec dinner with your leadership the evening of June 24th if that's possible.

Attendees (internal): myself, Hannah Lee (security), plus 2 infra engineers. We'd like an end-to-end demo focused on latency/throughput optimizations and private deployment options; a short SSO/security Q&A would be great.

Can you propose times for a 90-minute on-site slot and confirm dinner availability on the 24th? If procurement needs to be looped in for the office visit paperwork, let me know and I'll add them.

Thanks,
Sanjay
Sanjay Mehta
Senior Platform Engineer, FastScale

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Mehta <sanjay@fastscale.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Hannah Lee <hannah.lee@fastscale.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SF AI Conf week - onsite demo + exec dinner

Hi Sanjay - great to hear you'll be in town, and thanks for the context. We'd love to do both the onsite demo and the exec dinner. Quick notes & proposals: 

- Onsite demo: 90 minutes suggested. Available windows on Wed June 24: 10:00-11:30, 13:00-14:30, or 15:30-17:00 PT.
- Exec dinner: evening of June 24 - we can do 18:30 or 20:00. Would your CTO prefer a quieter private table (recommended) or an open reservation?
- Security/procurement: looping Dylan (SE) for technical prep and Aditya for procurement/contract touchpoints. If procurement needs an NDA or office visitor form, include procurement@fastscale.com and I'll coordinate.

I'm attaching a suggested agenda and will send a calendar invite once we lock the slot. 

Agenda attachment: SF-conf-demo-agenda-v1.pdf

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sanjay Mehta <sanjay@fastscale.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Lee <hannah.lee@fastscale.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SF AI Conf week - onsite demo + exec dinner

Thanks for the loop, Marissa. A few technical asks ahead of the onsite: 

- Can Sanjay share a rough target workload (tokens/sec, typical seq length) and whether you'll want private (VPC) deployment or a hosted evaluation?
- If we're demoing a private deployment, we'll need an SSH jump host or VPN access and a short list of allowed IPs for our test workers.
- For the security Q&A, Hannah - we can prepare SOC2 artifacts and a short runbook on data handling and KV cache behavior.

Happy to prep a short test harness - if you pick the 13:00 slot I can plan to bring a side-by-side latency walkthrough plus a live load run.

— Dylan
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Sanjay Mehta <sanjay@fastscale.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@fastscale.com>, Hannah Lee <hannah.lee@fastscale.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SF AI Conf week - onsite demo + exec dinner

Thanks, Marissa and Dylan. 13:00-14:30 on Wed June 24 works best for our team. CTO prefers 18:30 dinner (private table).

Answers to Dylan's asks: workload target ~ 1200 tokens/sec steady, spikes to ~4k for short bursts; typical seq length 512-1024. We prefer private/VPC evaluation for the demo. For access, we'll use our corporate VPN and can provide a test account + IP allowlist. Procurement will send the standard visitor agreement + NDA - adding procurement@procurement.fastscale.com to CC.

Please send the calendar invite and we'll confirm attendee names.

Sanjay

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Mehta <sanjay@fastscale.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@procurement.fastscale.com>, Hannah Lee <hannah.lee@fastscale.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 10:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SF AI Conf week - onsite demo + exec dinner

Perfect - locking 13:00-14:30 on Wed June 24 for the on-site demo and 18:30 for the exec dinner (private table). I've attached the agenda and am sending a calendar invite (ICS attached) - provisional attendees from Redwood: myself, Dylan, Aditya, Laura (customer success).

Procurement - when you have the visitor agreement and NDA, please send to laura_bennett@redwood.com and I'll route to our legal if needed. Hannah - I'll include the SOC2 artifacts link in the calendar notes.

Attachments: calendar-invite-20260624.ics

Agenda link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1example-agenda

Thanks everyone - see you in SF.

Best,
Marissa

Apologies for the late ask.

— Sanjay
